mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.vps_host_id AS vpsHostId, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, vh.name AS vpsHostName, vh.origin AS vpsHostOrigin, vh.status AS vpsHostStatus, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN vps_host vh ON f.vps_host_id = vh.id ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.vps_host_id AS vpsHostId, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, vh.name AS vpsHostName, vh.origin AS vpsHostOrigin, vh.status AS vpsHostStatus, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN vps_host vh ON f.vps_host_id = vh.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
